sv.title: Nvidia-beskedet lyfter Stockholmsbörsen
sv.summary: Beskedet från Nvidia att Jensen Huang återinsätts som vd lyfter Stockholmsbörsen, särskilt dess AI-exponerade aktier varav flera dubblar dagens uppgångar.

en.title: Nvidia news lifts the Stockholm Stock Exchange
en.summary: The news from Nvidia that Jensen Huang is being reinstated as CEO lifts the Stockholm Stock Exchange, especially its AI-exposed shares, several of which are doubling today's gains.
